planets.name: TOI-4662 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4662 with a 4.7-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-4662 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4662. Its orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
